definitions.gloss: to predict, to forecast, to project
definitions.explanation: To estimate or calculate in advance what will happen in the future based on data, patterns, or analysis. Used in weather, economics, science, and general forecasting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{予測|よそく}する。
⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{予測|よそく}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It is difficult to predict earthquakes accurately.

examples.japanese: AI⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{需要|じゅよう}→需要：02616_juyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{予測|よそく}する⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A system that uses AI to forecast demand was developed.

notes:
Implies a more analytical or data-based approach to predicting than ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧. Commonly used in scientific, technical, and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧⟦{不能|ふのう}→不能：28353_funou⟧: unpredictable
- ⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧⟦{変換|へんかん}→変換：12085_henkan⟧: predictive text (input)
- ⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧⟦{精度|せいど}→精度：13787_seido⟧: prediction accuracy
- ⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧: prediction model
- ⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧{値|ち}: predicted value

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{予想|よそう}する→予想する：06064_yosousuru⟧: to expect, to anticipate — more subjective, based on intuition or general judgment
- {予測|よそく}する: to predict, to forecast — more objective, based on data or scientific analysis
- ⟦{予報|よほう}→予報：03668_yohou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to forecast — specifically for weather and other official forecasts
